name: Clown Camp: Winter Party
source:
It's winter and Mitzy is ready to have some fun! She decides to host a winter party for her friends! Although, she cannot do it alone. With the help of her "best" friend Hellebore, can they get everything for the party? Hopefully!

Clown Camp Winter Party was made for the Winter Game Jam 2022.

[From [url=https://tyangerine.itch.io/clownwinter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
冬天到了，Mitzy准备好去享受乐趣了！她决定为她的朋友们举办一场冬季派对！虽然，她一个人做不到。在她“最好的”朋友黑黎芦的帮助下，他们能得到聚会所需的一切吗？希望如此！

小丑营冬季派对是为2022年冬季Game Jam举办的。

[来自[url=https://tyangerine.itch.io/clownwinter]Itch.io[/url]]
